persistentRules: Always check src/components for an existing reusable component before creating a new one.
Always define shared interfaces and types in src/types instead of redeclaring them inline.
Never use any in TypeScript code; prefer explicit types or unknown.
Treat src/App.tsx as the active router shell and treat src/Router.jsx as legacy unless a task explicitly targets it.
Preserve the repo's current styling model: MUI sx plus local CSS/SCSS, not Tailwind assumptions.
Preserve the current Vite asset path pattern and avoid introducing process.env.PUBLIC_URL.
